CVE-2019-18874.title: psutil (aka python-psutil) through 5.6.5 can have a double free.  ...
CVE-2019-18874.description: psutil (aka python-psutil) through 5.6.5 can have a double free. This occurs because of refcount mishandling within a while or for loop that converts system data into a Python object.
